name: calyx-mcp

tools.name: check_code_reflex
tools.description: Instant (<1ms) associative memory check of proposed code against past rewarded or punished bug patterns. Returns 'avoid', 'safe', or 'neutral'.

code.description: The proposed code snippet, function, or diff to evaluate.

context.description: Optional context or filename describing the task.

tools.name: remember_code_outcome
tools.description: Applies one-shot dopamine reward (test passed) or punishment (test failed/bug) to Mushroom Body synaptic weights.

code.description: The code snippet that was executed or tested.

outcome.description: The outcome of testing the code: 'success' (rewards synapses) or 'failure' (punishes synapses).

error_message.description: Optional error trace or description if the outcome was 'failure'.

tools.name: query_associative_memory
tools.description: Searches stored code patterns using Fly-LSH sparse binary Hamming similarity.

query_code.description: The code query to search against associative memory (accepts 'query_code', 'query', or 'code').

top_k.description: Number of nearest neighbors to return.

compact.description: Whether to return compact match objects to reduce prompt token footprint.

tools.name: inspect_memory_state
tools.description: Returns total active memories, synaptic weight distribution, and health statistics of the Mushroom Body.

tools.name: reset_memory
tools.description: Resets or prunes the synaptic weights and associative memory back to baseline.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm reset.

backup.description: Whether to create a backup file before resetting.
